name: Unique participants
definition: Resolved persons (participant_id) with at least one valid registration in the participation year (rules C1, C2, C3). The north-star metric. A person counts once however many leagues, divisions or countries they played in.

name: Valid registrations
definition: Registration records that are not exact duplicates and whose season falls in the participation year (rule C2). Records with an impossible DOB count: the person is real, only the DOB is bad.

name: Registrations per participant
definition: Valid registrations divided by unique participants for the same year and grain. A depth measure: multi-league and spring-plus-fall players raise it.

name: Multi-organization participants
definition: Unique participants with valid registrations in two or more organizations (leagues, clubs, federation clubs) in the year (rule C5). Counted once in the global count and in each organization's own count.

name: Multi-country participants
definition: Unique participants with valid registrations in two or more countries in the year (rule C6). The difference between the presence and attributed country views.

name: New participants
definition: Unique participants whose first valid registration year is this year (rule C11). The first observed year is excluded: with no earlier data every participant would look new (left-censored).

name: Returning participants
definition: Unique participants with a valid registration this year and the prior year (rule C12). Not defined for the first observed year.

name: Reactivated participants
definition: Unique participants with a valid registration this year, none last year, and at least one earlier year (rule C13). Only possible from the third observed year (it needs an earlier year plus a gap year).

name: Censored participants (first data year)
definition: Unique participants in the first year of data, whose new / returning status cannot be known because earlier years are not in the data (rule C11).

name: Year-over-year retention rate
definition: Returning participants divided by the prior year's unique participants (rule C12). Defined from the second observed year (the first has no prior year in the data).

name: Participants (country-attributed)
definition: Unique participants assigned to the country of their most recent registration in the year (rule C6). Sums exactly to the global unique participants.

name: Participants (country-presence)
definition: Unique participants counted in every country they played in during the year (rule C6). Sums to MORE than the global count by the number of multi-country participants; never sum it for a global figure.

name: Participants (segment)
definition: Unique participants in a segment (country, age band, primary division, sex, youth flag) for the year. Additive within one grouping set; subtotal rows are labelled by grouping_id.

name: Youth participants
definition: Unique participants aged 17 or under on December 31 of the participation year (rules C7, C10).

name: Youth girls participants
definition: Unique youth participants (age 17 or under at December 31) whose registration-reported sex is F (rules C7, C9, C10). Reported sex only; gender identity is not collected.

name: Girls' share of youth participation
definition: Youth girls participants divided by youth participants (sex F, M and U all in the denominator; U is never imputed, rule C9).

name: International participants (attributed, outside the US)
definition: Unique participants whose attributed country (rule C6) is not US.

name: Countries with at least one participant
definition: Number of countries with one or more attributed participants in the year, after reading the data (suppression does not apply to this count).

name: Unique participants, low bound
definition: Unique participants if every PROBABLE pair is really one person (AUTO + PROBABLE + steward edges). Computed with the same connected-components macro as the point estimate, with no ground truth.

name: Unique participants, point estimate
definition: Unique participants from the production edge set. Equals unique_participants.

name: Unique participants, high bound
definition: Unique participants if every cluster with an open integrity issue is really several people (production edges minus the edges inside flagged clusters).

name: Identity range (% of point estimate)
definition: (high - low) / point estimate. How much identity resolution alone could move the count. Covers identity only, not source coverage or data entry errors in the sources.

name: Participants resolved with high confidence
definition: Share of unique participants whose resolution confidence is SINGLETON, DETERMINISTIC_ONLY, HIGH or REVIEWED and who sit in no cluster with an open integrity issue and touch no open review item.

name: Open review items
definition: Items in the identity review queue (cluster conflicts and probable pairs) awaiting a steward decision.

name: Participants touched by open review items
definition: Unique participants in a cluster flagged for integrity, or with a record in an open probable pair, in the year.

name: Participants in clusters with an open integrity issue
definition: Unique participants in clusters flagged by idr_cluster_integrity (rule C14). They are counted in unique_participants; this reports how many.

name: Sources onboarded
definition: Sources at Modelled or Production status in the source inventory.

name: Sources known
definition: Sources in the source inventory at any status, including those not yet onboarded.

name: Registrations failing DQ rules
definition: Share of ALL registration records in the year (duplicates included) carrying at least one flag classified AFFECTS_COUNT in dq_flag_severity: duplicates, impossible or unparseable DOB, unmapped values. Missing values and normalized flags are not counted. Reported next to the headline numbers.

name: Reported headcount (school and recreation programs)
definition: Children counted in school and recreation program headcounts reported by partners (Source E), summed over programs after the staging repairs (latest report per program-year; girls + boys where the stated total disagrees). NOT participants: aggregates cannot be deduplicated against people, so this is never added to unique_participants. PE_UNIT rows are exposure, not participation.

name: Voluntary program headcount
definition: Reported headcount in INTRAMURAL and AFTER_SCHOOL programs only (children who chose to take part), excluding PE_UNIT exposure. Same aggregate caveats as reported_headcount.

name: Combined reach, lower bound
definition: unique_participants (point) plus the part of the reported headcount that cannot be a registered participant: reported headcount minus the maximum possible overlap. A bound, not an estimate.

name: Combined reach, upper bound
definition: unique_participants (high) plus the full reported headcount (no overlap assumed). A bound, not an estimate.

name: Programs reporting headcounts
definition: Number of school and recreation programs (program-years, after the latest report wins) that reported a headcount in the year (Source E). Used to decide small-cell suppression of the headcounts.

name: Entry cohort size
definition: Participants whose first observed participation year is the cohort year, excluding the first data year (everyone active then may have started earlier, so that year is left-censored).

name: Retention (Kaplan-Meier survival)
definition: Probability that an entrant is still registered k years after entry, S(k) = product of (1 - churn events / at risk) over the steps up to k. A churn event is the FIRST gap: no registration in the next year while still youth-eligible. An age-out (turning 18) and the end of the data are CENSORED, not churn. Reactivation is reported separately. Reported with Greenwood 95% intervals.
grain: entry cohorts pooled x segment x years since entry

name: Entrants at risk
definition: Entrants observed and youth-eligible at step k whose first gap has not yet happened (the denominator of the retention step).

name: Churn events
definition: Entrants whose first gap, while still youth-eligible, is at step k.

name: Censored entrants
definition: Entrants whose follow-up stopped after step k without an event: AGE_OUT (turned 18) or FINAL_YEAR (the future is unknown). Not churn.

name: Cohort share still registered
definition: Share of an entry cohort with a registration k years after entry. NOT corrected for age-outs, so it understates retention for older youth; retention_among_eligible removes players who aged past the youth range.
grain: entry cohort x years since entry

name: Fan engagement uplift after first registration
definition: Estimated change in events per household-month after a household first registers a child, as a percent of the participants' counterfactual level. NAIVE compares participant and non-participant fan households over the same months and is biased by who enrolls; DID_ADDITIVE is the matched difference-in-differences. Describes LINKED households only (ADR-009, ADR-010).

name: Fan engagement uplift, lower 95% bound
definition: Lower end of the analytic 95% interval of fan_uplift_pct (estimate - 1.96 se). Somewhat too narrow: comparison accounts repeat across event months (ADR-010).

name: Fan engagement uplift, upper 95% bound
definition: Upper end of the analytic 95% interval of fan_uplift_pct (estimate + 1.96 se).

name: Linked participant households in the estimate
definition: Participant households linked to a fan account that were matched to at least one comparison (not left-censored, enough pre and post months).

name: Match rate
definition: Share of eligible linked participant households that found a comparison.

name: Households in the program
definition: Observed households: participants grouped by shared guardian contact; an adult player is a household of one (ADR-009).

name: Households linked to a fan account
definition: Households with a deterministic one-to-one link to a fan account (email, then phone).

name: Household link rate
definition: Linked households / program households. Linked households are not a random sample (ADR-009): the rate by country shows who is reachable.

name: Event-study effect
definition: Participants' mean events per month / matched comparisons' mean - 1, by month relative to the first registration (-12 to +18). A flat pre period supports the design.

name: Event-study standard error
definition: Approximate standard error of the participants - comparisons difference in events per household-month at each month relative to event time.

name: Participants' mean events per month
definition: Mean fan events per household-month for matched linked participant households at each month relative to event time.

name: Comparisons' mean events per month
definition: Weighted mean fan events per account-month for matched comparison accounts at each month relative to the matched household's event time.

name: Retention, lower 95% bound
definition: Lower end of the Kaplan-Meier 95% interval (Greenwood standard error, S - 1.96 se, clipped at 0).
grain: entry cohorts x segment x years since entry

name: Retention, upper 95% bound
definition: Upper end of the Kaplan-Meier 95% interval (S + 1.96 se, clipped at 1).
grain: entry cohorts x segment x years since entry

name: Cohort share still registered, among eligible
definition: Share of an entry cohort registered k years after entry, among players who have not aged past the youth range (the fairer share than cohort_retention_pct).
grain: entry cohorts x segment x years since entry

name: Funnel: registered households
definition: Participant households registered in the cohort year (the top of the fan funnel). NULL segment / status = all.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: linked to a fan account
definition: Households with a deterministic one-to-one link to a fan account. UNLINKED households are unknown, not non-fans.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: contactable
definition: Linked households with a guardian account opted in on at least one channel. No consent record is not 'no', and is not counted.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: active
definition: Linked households whose account had engagement within the active window (fan_params).
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: monetized
definition: Linked households with net spend above zero in the trailing window (synthetic currency).
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: link rate
definition: Linked / registered households.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: contactable rate
definition: Contactable / linked households.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: active rate
definition: Active / linked households.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Funnel: monetized rate
definition: Monetized / active households.
grain: cohort year x segment x fan status

name: Incremental fan accounts
definition: Fan accounts that would not exist without the programme, from a stacked cohort comparison of launching markets with not-yet-launched markets (ADR-011). An estimate with an interval.

name: Incremental fan accounts, lower bound
definition: Lower end of the 95% interval of incremental_fan_accounts.

name: Incremental fan accounts, upper bound
definition: Upper end of the 95% interval of incremental_fan_accounts.

name: Net-new linked households
definition: Linked households with no fan account before their first registration. Not incremental: some would have joined anyway.

name: Net-new households, scaled by link rate
definition: net_new_linked_households divided by the link rate: the naive size of the acquired base, shown next to the incremental estimate.

name: Market-years compared
definition: Treated and control market-years behind the incrementality estimate.

name: Accounts in the value estimate
definition: Canonical fan accounts in a fan group behind a lifetime-value estimate.

name: Net spend per active month
definition: Mean net spend (synthetic currency) in months the account is active.

name: Expected active months
definition: Expected months active over the horizon from a Kaplan-Meier lapse curve.

name: Fan lifetime value
definition: Net spend per active month x expected active months over the horizon. Synthetic currency, illustrative, not revenue.

name: Fan lifetime value, lower bound
definition: Lower end of the lifetime-value range.

name: Fan lifetime value, upper bound
definition: Upper end of the lifetime-value range.

name: Audience: registered households
definition: Participant households registered by the month end.

name: Audience: linked households
definition: Registered households linked to a fan account.

name: Addressable audience
definition: Linked households with a guardian opted in on at least one channel. The size of the audience the organisation may talk to. A count, never a list.

name: Addressable audience: email
definition: Households opted in on email. Households can be in several channels, so channels do not add up.

name: Addressable audience: SMS
definition: Households opted in on SMS.

name: Addressable audience: push
definition: Households opted in on push.

name: Audience: active households
definition: Linked households with an active account at the month end.

name: Consent gap
definition: Active households with no channel opted in: engaged and not contactable.

name: Contactable share of linked
definition: audience_contactable / audience_linked.

name: Consent gap share of active
definition: consent_gap_households / audience_active.

name: Consent gap value
definition: Gap households x median monetized spend. Synthetic currency, illustrative opportunity size, not revenue.

name: Participant households (market)
definition: Households with a registered participant in a market, from the market profile.

name: Fan accounts (market)
definition: Canonical fan accounts in a market.

name: Participant households per 1,000
definition: Participant households per 1,000 households in the (synthetic) market population.

name: Fan accounts per 1,000
definition: Fan accounts per 1,000 households in the (synthetic) market population.

name: Net-new rate
definition: Net-new households / linked households in a market.

name: Link rate (market)
definition: Linked / participant households in a market.

name: RFM accounts
definition: Fan accounts in an RFM segment (quintile-based recency, frequency, monetary) for the year and fan group.
grain: year x fan group x segment

name: RFM segment share
definition: rfm_accounts / accounts in the fan group.
grain: year x fan group x segment

name: Fan accounts at risk
definition: Accounts still under observation and not lapsed at the start of a month since origin.

name: Fan survival
definition: Kaplan-Meier probability a fan account has not lapsed by months since origin. Active accounts at the end of the data are censored.

name: Fan survival, lower bound
definition: Lower end of the 95% Greenwood interval.

name: Fan survival, upper bound
definition: Upper end of the 95% Greenwood interval.

name: Households in the value uplift
definition: Linked existing-fan households matched to a comparison for the outcome.

name: Value uplift per household-month
definition: Matched before/after difference in the outcome per household-month (events or synthetic currency).

name: Value uplift, lower bound
definition: Lower end of the 95% interval of uplift_per_month.

name: Value uplift, upper bound
definition: Upper end of the 95% interval of uplift_per_month.

name: Value uplift, percent
definition: uplift as a share of the counterfactual level; shown only where the baseline is large enough to be stable.

name: Value uplift, naive percent
definition: Participants vs non-participants without matching or a before period. Shown to be read against the matched estimate.

name: Consent lines
definition: Latest consent status per account and channel with a record. No record is not in the count.

name: Consent opt-ins
definition: Consent lines whose latest status is opt-in.

name: Consent capture rate
definition: consent_opt_ins / consent_lines for a capture point and channel.

name: Net-new households
definition: Linked households with no fan account before their first registration, by cohort year (a household counts in the year of its first registration). Not incremental: some would have joined anyway.
